title: Legora announces firmwide rollout at Skadden
summary: Legora is pleased to announce that its agentic operating system for legal professionals has been rolled out globally at Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP
body_markdown:
Legora is now available to all firm personnel, as the two organizations work together on firm-specific assets


Legora is pleased to announce that its agentic operating system for legal professionals has been rolled out globally at Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP. The firm’s approximately 1,700 lawyers across all practice groups have access to legal engineering support to build firm-specific assets, skills libraries and workflows, as well as capabilities that draw on the firm’s knowledge and how its lawyers work


Skadden advises on some of the most complex transactions, disputes and regulatory matters in the world. Adding Legora to the firm’s suite of AI solutions supports the firm’s client service efforts, complements its existing technology and offers Skadden lawyers a platform for analysis, review and drafting.


“As we continue to invest in our technology infrastructure, we are thoughtfully integrating AI into our practice, focusing on tools that enhance our ability to achieve optimal results for our clients,” said Vince DiMascio, Skadden’s Chief Digital and Information Officer. “Building practice-specific solutions with Legora allows us to apply our lawyers' experience and judgment more effectively.”


“Skadden holds itself to the highest standard on every matter, and that is the standard we build for. The Legora aOS carries the firm’s own knowledge into every piece of work and keeps it under the controls a firm like Skadden requires, so its lawyers can put agents to work on the matters that matter most,” said Max Junestrand, CEO and co-founder of Legora.


Skadden joins a growing list of leading firms, including half of the *Am Law* 50, and in-house legal teams working in Legora. The platform is used by more than 150,000 legal professionals at more than 2,900 customers across 80 markets.


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 150,000 legal professionals at more than 2,900 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.
